title: His California band's personnel and a ballroom in San Bernardino
summary: He lists the band members, including Jack McVea, Snake White, Al Morgan, Dudley Brooks, Lee Young and Tyree Glenn, working at a San Bernardino ballroom.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: But anyway, we played -- I put this band together and Les Hite was playing at the SEBASTIAN'S Cotton Club. And I used to rehearse over to at the union and I knew Lionel, used to come down there. I used to write somethings for him when he had his band. Then he went into the Cotton Club with his band. He had Herschel Evans and a bunch of follows with him out at the Cotton Club.

So we played around down to -- in California, San Bernadino. I met a man there and he put my band out in San Bernadino. And I had me, there was me and Don Byas, Jack McVee was playing and Paul Howard and Hugo Dandridge. That was the saxophone section. And I sent out and got Snake White as trumpeter, my friend, and he came and played trumpet. And I had a fellow named Red Mack on trumpet and another fellow named Peewee Brice on trumpet. Then I had -- Al Morgan came to play bass with me and I had Dudley Brooks on piano.
Did you have Duke Brooks later? Do I remember Duke Brooks?
I don't know. Dudley Brooks came in and he learned how to write and he started to be a writer out in California.
Just some records that Teddy Edwards
made in the mid-forties with Duke Brooks on piano.
Yeah, I think it's probably the same.
And I had Lee Young on drums, Lester's brother. And I had a fellow named -- we used to call him Mr. Confrey on trombone, I can't think of his last name. And Tyree Glenn on the other trombone.
